scope: 真实 LCVEX SoC A10 顶层 synthesis/fit 实验；主 RTL 显式 M20K BRAM；不使用 core/coh/AXI stub。

design.internal: lcvex_catapult_soc_top / lcvex_core / coherent + AXI + L1/L2 (no stubs)
design.bram: main RTL SYNTHESIS-aware explicit altera_syncram M20K wrapper

runs.command: quartus_sh --flow compile real_a10 -c real_a10 -start ipgenerate -end ipgenerate
runs.summary: Qsys/IP generation PASS; existing default generation policy skipped regeneration of read-only platform IP.

runs.command: quartus_sh --flow compile real_a10 -c real_a10 -start synthesis -end synthesis
runs.summary: Real SoC synthesis PASS; explicit M20K BRAM confirmed; cache data arrays still not M20K, causing ~342k ALM estimate.

runs.command: quartus_sh --flow compile real_a10 -c real_a10 -start fitter -end fitter
runs.stopped: manual kill after no final fit report in 64m21s; no fit.summary/fit.rpt
runs.summary: Fitter did not complete; placement/routing burden from LUT-implemented cache data arrays. Peak memory is not the blocker.

artifacts.reproduce: Quartus project real_a10; QSF/SDC isolated copies under equal root
Synthesis report with M20K BRAM and resource summary
Same PM/WS sampler used for ipgenerate/synthesis/fitter

known_limits: Fitter not completed; no fit resources/STA/assembler/SOF in this task.
L1D/L2 cache data arrays still not mapped to M20K; only BRAM and platform FIFO/EMIF block memory present.
Current main RTL required several Quartus 21.4 compatibility patches in the isolated experiment; these are not yet merged/verified in Verilator.
Experiment uses A64_FP_SIMD=0 and reduced L2 geometry; not a full-B5 signoff.
No original remote QSF/SDC/RTL modified; no license read.
next: Create explicit M20K/data-RAM wrappers for L1D and L2 cache arrays, then rerun synthesis/fitter/STA/assembler.
